scientific_integrity: A polynomial-size upper bound, for every fixed finite Boolean basis and all Euclidean frames, deduced from a proved successor-cluster lemma and a published S5 polynomial translation theorem. Finite tests are auxiliary only. No external independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: No explicit optimal polynomial exponent or lower bound is claimed.
Potential equivalent prior treatment in Euclidean normal-form literature remains a residual originality risk.
The full text of Georgiev (2017) could not be inspected; its accessible abstract discusses modal depth, not succinctness.
title: Polynomial Boolean-basis elimination on Euclidean Kripke frames
